candidate_relations.reason: The benchmark diagnosis is CD8-positive granulomatous cutaneous T-cell lymphoma; the record emphasizes a lymphohistiocytic/granulomatous infiltrate with clonal CD8-predominant T cells, while mycosis fungoides is a distinct clinicopathologic subtype not established here.
